name: go2-foxglove
description: Stream a Unitree Go2's validated, canonical data into Foxglove: front camera, joints, IMU, battery, foot force, pose + TF, UWB, and LiDAR over one WebSocket. Avoids raw-DDS duplicate-schema failures and ships a ready-made Foxglove layout.

variables.name: FOXGLOVE_PORT
variables.description: Port for the Foxglove WebSocket — open Foxglove → Open Connection → ws://<device>:<port>

variables.name: GO2_IP
variables.description: Go2 controller IP on the robot LAN (DDS and WebRTC camera)
